description: This file contains a function 'dashBoardDisplayChart' which generates various dashboard charts based on request parameters, user permissions, and data queries within a CRM system. It includes numerous SQL queries, permission checks, and rendering logic for different modules such as Leads, Accounts, Opportunities, and support tickets.

methods.name: dashBoardDisplayChart
methods.description: Generates and displays dashboard charts based on user permissions, module data, and request parameters. It supports generating HTML or direct chart outputs for different modules such as Leads, Accounts, Opportunities, Quotes, Invoices, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Tickets, and Contacts.

methods.name: getDashboardQuery
methods.description: Constructs a secure SQL query string for a given module by appending access control filters based on current user permissions.

methods.name: picklist_check
methods.description: Checks user role permissions for a specific picklist field in a module and returns a SQL condition to restrict data based on role-based picklist values.
